name: Oedipus Arc
axiom: The flaw was in the system from the start; revelation is what makes it collapse.
trigger: Post-mortems of strategic miscalculations, where the audience needs to see that the cause predates the failure.

steps.text: Unrecognised flaw: the assumption everyone shares.
Temporary relief: the workaround that appears to solve it.
Revelation: the evidence that the assumption was false.
Systemic collapse: everything built on it fails together.

antiPattern.violation: Naming a villain, which lets the audience conclude that removing one person would have averted the collapse.
antiPattern.remediation: Trace the flaw to a decision the audience would also have made, then show what it was load-bearing for.
